title: Customer Enablement Manager
description:
Hello, we’re Instrumentl . 👋
Nonprofits do some of the most important work in the world, and most of them are still managing grants in spreadsheets. We're fixing that.
Instrumentl is a profitable, hypergrowth, YC-backed SaaS platform building the operating system for grant-funded organizations. More than 5,500 nonprofits use Instrumentl to discover, track, and win grant funding, from local community organizations to the San Diego Zoo and the University of Alaska. Collectively they’ve moved over $1 billion through our platform.
We're growing quickly, customers love us (check out our G2 reviews!), and we're hiring people who want to build something that matters.
About the role:
We’re hiring a Customer Enablement Manager , reporting to the Manager, Customer Success to create and deliver educational experiences for customers at every stage of their journey. You’ll be an advocate for our customers from onboarding through driving new engagement, gathering product feedback, and ensuring product adoption - scaling our CS efforts as Instrumentl grows.

What you'll do:

Customer Education & Onboarding

• Build and deploy educational materials that improve customer onboarding, product adoption, and awareness of Instrumentl ’s value prop

• Create and deliver high-impact training programs and identify new opportunities for customer education

• Create and maintain self-serve resources for customers
Communications & Engagement

• Own a customer communication strategy that drives engagement and promotes brand loyalty

• Leverage quantitative and qualitative data to drive segmentation strategies and dynamic personalization for various communication efforts

• Develop, manage, and maintain data-driven messaging campaigns with high open rates and low opt-out rates to create a coherent customer journey and improve product adoption
Retention & Advocacy

• Scale customer retention and identify upsell opportunities using a metrics-backed approach

• Serve as the voice of our customers, share customer feedback, and advocate for our customers’ needs, especially with revenue and product teams

• Assist with customer support questions and day-to-day tasks that enable our team and customers

What we're looking for:

Required

• 2+ years of customer-facing work experience, ideally in a Customer Success, Onboarding, or Training role in a SaaS environment

• Customer education and onboarding: able to manage customer onboarding processes that combine human interaction and self-service tools

• Community engagement and program design: able to conceptualize, build, and lead creative customer engagement efforts that turn users into vocal advocates

• Communication: you pride yourself on your ability to communicate complex topics easily over video and in writing

• Empathy: warm and approachable, genuinely interested in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues and customers

• Adaptability: thrives in fast-paced environments and comfortable handling ambiguity and change

• Ownership: proactive approach to process improvement with the confidence to execute on new ideas

• Tech savviness: familiar with tools like G Suite, Zoom, Slack, Intercom, and Canva

• Growth mindset: takes feedback in stride and exhibits a growth mindset every day
Nice to Have

• Experience working with nonprofit or SMB customers

• Background in nonprofit development or fundraising

• Experience in an early-stage startup environment

• Experience working remotely

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on Canadian public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialized role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations.

- Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology-and amazing people.
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
What you'll be doing

• Integrate customers by assisting with license registration, entitlement activation, support access, and initial value planning.

• Conduct needs assessments to align customer workloads with NVIDIA software libraries, frameworks, reference architectures, and platform capabilities.

• Collaboratively define and track success metrics tied to business outcomes, workload performance, adoption health, and renewal readiness.

• Promote adoption and growth across NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Run:ai, Mission Control, NIM, NeMo, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, CUDA-X libraries, DGX OS, Omniverse/Physical AI, vGPU, and associated software.

• Coordinate field teams, solution architects, support, product, engineering, partners, and customer collaborators to remove adoption blockers and accelerate time to value.

• Lead customer health reviews and executive readouts that connect technical adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

• Capture repeatable adoption patterns and customer feedback to improve enablement, support quality, and the overall customer experience.

What we need to see

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• At least 8+ years working in customer success, technical account management, solution architecture, professional services, support leadership, or enterprise software deployment.

• Customer-first approach with a genuine passion for helping customers achieve their goals and delivering outstanding experiences.

• Technical curiosity and agility, with eagerness to learn emerging AI technologies and stay current in a rapidly evolving landscape.

• Strong technical foundation across AI/ML concepts, accelerated computing workloads, cloud/on-prem infrastructure, and NVIDIA software.

• Consultative engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for diverse collaborators.

• Experience managing complex customer relationships across technical users, business owners, executives, partners, and support teams.

• Strategic perspective gained from experience in AI, accelerated computing, high-performance computing, cloud, or enterprise software settings.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

• Active listening and discovery skills that uncover the customer's platform, difficulties, operating model, and strategic objectives.

• Ability to rapidly assimilate complex customer environments and map their challenges to practical NVIDIA platform recommendations.

• Strength in simplifying complex technical architectures into clear, actionable mentorship for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Visible passion for AI innovation and proficiency in accelerated computing, enterprise AI, and modern software adoption patterns.

• Proven success in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, Customer Engineer, Customer Success Manager, or similar.

title: Group Copy Supervisor
description:
PROJECT MANAGER | Relevate Health

WHO WE ARE
At Relevate Health , we believe every HCP communication should be relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people committed to making that vision a reality. We're healthcare marketing experts who push ourselves every single day to deliver life-changing engagement for the clients and patients who depend on us. Our culture is collaborative, growth-minded, and energized by purpose.
THE OPPORTUNITY
We're growing our Creative team and looking for a sharp, strategic Group Copy Supervisor to join our expanding market access and health system practice. This role puts you at the intersection of science, strategy, and storytelling: leading copy across a portfolio of high-profile pharmaceutical accounts and driving creative that helps payers, health systems, and providers make informed decisions about today's most important therapies.
You'll own copy from brief through final delivery. You'll be the creative voice across PIE presentations, value proposition decks, patient and payer education materials, workshop decks, and more. You'll mentor and lead junior copywriters, collaborate daily with art, strategy, account, and medical teams, and show up with confidence and rationale in both internal and client-facing settings.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead and own copy development end-to-end across market access and health system materials, including PIE presentations, value proposition decks, leave-behinds, implementation guides, playbooks, case studies, objection handlers, training materials, infographics, and provider/patient/payer education materials

• Manage, mentor, and supervise Junior Copywriters, Copywriters, and Senior Copywriters across day-to-day work and longer-term development

• Collaborate closely with art, strategy, account, PM, and medical teams to ensure creative is on brief, on brand, and on time

• Help develop and review project and creative briefs

• Originate fresh, innovative concepts and transform them into effective copy across digital and print platforms, including websites, email, social media, and interactive digital tactics

• Communicate complex medical and market access topics in a clean, concise, and medically accurate manner

• Present work with confidence and thoughtful rationale. Clearly articulate copy decisions to internal teams and clients

• Ensure editorial accuracy throughout the MLR process, including annotations and references

• Participate in RFPs, pitches, and concept development

• Connect with target audiences by applying insights from behavioral research, journey maps, and data

• Proactively identify risks related to timing, process, or creative quality and come with a mitigation plan

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Must-Haves:

• Strong copywriting background with direct experience in market access and/or health system marketing at a market access agency

• Ability to own a project from brief to final delivery and effectively direct others across large or multiple simultaneous projects

• Demonstrated ability to consume, analyze, and translate complex medical and market access literature into compelling copy

• Expertise in editorial accuracy, including MLR-compliant annotations and references

• Conceptual thinking that pushes work beyond the expected

• Confident, polished client presence. You know how to read the room and adjust in real time

• Excellent listener who builds strong, trusted relationships across internal and client teams

• Strong organizational and self-management skills with a clear sense of urgency

• Ability to think quickly and adapt well in fast-paced, high-pressure situations

• Self-aware. You know your strengths, own your gaps, and seek input when needed

Big Pluses:

• Experience with Amgen, Sanofi, Regeneron, or similar large pharma accounts

• Familiarity with ProofHQ or similar review platforms

• Experience with LLM platforms integrated into a creative workflow

• Comfort with health system strategy and payer/access land

title: Email Marketing Technical Specialist

As an Elite Klaviyo Partner, we pride ourselves on delivering impactful results for our clients.

You will work closely with strategists to implement detailed segmentation, automation, and dynamic content. QA and Testing: Thoroughly test email and SMS campaigns to ensure they are technically free of errors, consistent in look and feel, and meet the specified requirements before deployment. This includes checking for spelling errors and using tools like Litmus for additional QA.

•
Campaign Scheduling: Manage the scheduling and execution of campaigns, ensuring they go live as planned.

•
Segmentation Setup: Create and maintain audience segments based on specific criteria to target the right audiences effectively.

•
Flow and Automation Setup: Implement flows and automations in platforms like Klaviyo and Yotpo, following flow logic and briefs provided by the strategy team.

Attention to Detail: A meticulous approach to checking and validating work, ensuring all campaigns are technically error-free and maintain consistency across different ESPs. High attention to detail is crucial, particularly when using tools like Litmus for QA.

•
Clear Communication: Effective communication skills, particularly in remote working environments, using platforms like Slack and Asana.

•
Technical Expertise: Extensive experience with Klaviyo is essential, along with familiarity with platforms like Yotpo and Justuno.

•
Remote Work Proficiency: Comfortable and effective in a remote work environment, managing tasks and deadlines independently.

•
Task Management: Ability to balance and juggle multiple tasks while maintaining high levels of organisation and efficiency.

•
Organisation: Highly organised, with the capability to manage various aspects of email marketing projects concurrently.

Why Join Us?

•
Remote Work Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a remote working environment, with access to industry-standard platforms like Slack and Asana.

•

We are rapidly expanding across markets nationwide with leading employers and health plans, building the infrastructure for value-based MSK care at scale.

• Be Direct with Respect - We communicate clearly, with honesty and care.

• Move as One Team - We win together, across roles and functions.

This is a senior leadership role on RightMove’s Growth team, responsible for expanding our payer, employer, and strategic partner relationships.

As Vice President, Commercial Partnerships , you will own the strategy and execution required to convert RightMove’s clinical model, HSS partnership, AI-enabled platform, and value-based economics into scalable commercial partnerships.

title: Senior Regulatory Analyst and Writer
description:

Type: Full time, salaried.
Eligibility: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident.
The role
This is the analytical center of the contract and the face of it to the client. When a comment period closes on a proposed Packers and Stockyards Act rule, you are the person who reads what the public sent in, works out what actually matters in it, and turns thousands of pages into something the agency's policy staff can use to write a final rule.
Between rulemakings you run the contract: the deliverable tracking, the monthly reporting, the weekly client meetings, and the readiness work that makes the next sprint survivable. You will also direct the analyst bench during comment closes, setting the coding scheme and reviewing what comes back.
The turnaround is fifteen calendar days from the close of the comment period for both the substantive analysis and the key issues matrix, and the client has signaled they may want it faster. This job suits someone who does careful work quickly and does not need to be managed through a deadline.
Analysis and writing

• Analyze public comments submitted on proposed rules, identifying themes, high-risk issues, quantitative metrics such as comment counts by topic, recommendations from the public, and the line between substantive and non-substantive submissions.

• Distinguish organized form-letter campaigns from unique substantive comments and account for both in the analysis.

• Identify every issue raised through public comment and build the key issues matrix, with comments sorted and categorized by issue for policy discussion and for drafting written responses in the final rule.

• Write summaries that hold up under legal and policy review and that support the agency's response obligations under the Administrative Procedure Act.

• Deliver written material that meets federal, and preferably USDA, style guidance and Section 508 accessibility requirements.

• Set the coding scheme for each rulemaking and review the analyst bench's output against it.

Running the contract

• Maintain a one-page deliverable tracking sheet, updated weekly and submitted electronically to the client throughout the contract.

• Lead the kick-off meeting within ten business days of award and develop the project plan that follows from it.

• Write and submit monthly progress reports to the Contracting Officer's Representative covering technical progress, schedule status, and any concerns or recommendations.

• Run weekly virtual status meetings with the client on comment volume, processing progress, schedule risk, and emerging themes, and document decisions in internal meeting notes.

• Forecast comment volume as it accumulates and tell Connexus early how much bench support each close will need.

• Escalate anything that looks like scope creep to Connexus management rather than absorbing it.

What you need

• Bachelor's degree. Advanced degree in public policy, law, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field is welcome.

• Thorough working understanding of the federal notice-and-comment rulemaking process and the Administrative Procedure Act.

• Direct experience analyzing or responding to public comments on a federal rulemaking, whether at an agency, a contractor, a law firm, or a trade association.

• Demonstrable knowledge of federal regulatory and stylistic requirements for public comment processing and rulemaking.

• Strong analytical writing. You will be asked for a writing sample.

• Familiarity with the Federal Document Management System and regulations.gov.

• Experience producing Section 508 compliant documents.

• Comfortable owning a client relationship, including writing status reports a federal reviewer will read closely.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Zoom, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.

Nice to have

• USDA experience, particularly with AMS, or familiarity with the Packers and Sto

title: Analytics Platforms Architect
description:
About Tala
 
Tala is AI-native credit infrastructure for the global majority, combining proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. Backed by more than $500 million in funding, Tala has distributed more than $7 billion in capital to more than 13 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia-building one of the most robust datasets on thin-file borrowers anywhere in the world. Our mission is simple yet bold: to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We are looking for daring, data-driven leaders passionate about building the trust and credit infrastructure for the global majority.
 
Our pioneering work and proven impact have earned us consistent recognition, including being named to:
CNBC’s Disruptor 50 for five years.
CNBC’s World's Top Fintech Companies for two consecutive years.
Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years.
Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success.
 
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
 
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role 
We're looking for an Analytics Platforms Architect to be the senior technical leader responsible for making Tala's data easier to trust, understand, access, and use across the company.
This is a highly hands-on technical leadership role. You'll define the architecture and technical direction for shared data and analytics platforms while also building alongside our engineers.
You'll work across Product, Analytics, Engineering, Finance, and Accounting to create infrastructure that becomes the foundation for how Tala uses data. A major focus will be building a semantic layer that gives the organization consistent, governed definitions for important business metrics. You'll also help establish how our analytics teams and AI tools safely work with that data.
This isn't an architecture role where you simply create designs and hand them off to someone else. You'll be expected to make technical decisions, write code, build production systems, and drive important platform initiatives through delivery.
Initially, this role is an individual contributor position with no direct reports, operating at a Principal/Staff-level scope. As our platform organization grows, there will be an opportunity to build and lead a team.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Lila is hiring a Scientific Leader to build and run our experimental soft materials team, covering formulations, polymers, colloids, gels, emulsions, inks, adhesives, and coatings. • Deep soft-matter fundamentals: phase behavior, self-assembly, rheology, interfacial phenomena, colloid and dispersion stability, transport, cure and crosslinking
